set -euo pipefail; DB="$HOME/agent-workspace/review/photomap-2026-09-12/app.db"; DB="$DB" python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(os.environ['DB']); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
rows=c.execute("select ph.id,ph.place_id,p.title,ph.caption,ph.thumb_path,ph.description_blocks,length(coalesce(ph.description_blocks,'')) chars from photo ph join place p on p.id=ph.place_id where ph.status='approved' order by chars desc limit 5").fetchall()
for r in rows:
    raw=r['description_blocks'] or '[]'
    try: blocks=json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw,str) else raw
    except Exception: blocks=[]
    texts=[str(b.get('text','')).strip() for b in blocks if isinstance(b,dict) and str(b.get('text','')).strip()]
    preview=' '.join(texts)[:700]
    item={'id':r['id'],'place_id':r['place_id'],'title':r['title'],'caption':r['caption'] or '', 'chars':r['chars'],'block_count':len(blocks) if isinstance(blocks,list) else 0,'preview':preview,'thumb_url':'https://photomap.pl'+(r['thumb_path'] or '')}
    print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
c.close()
PY
